name: Sodium diisopropylnaphthalenesulfonate
description: Sodium diisopropylnaphthalenesulfonate (CAS 1322-93-6 ) is an anionic surfactant used across industrial formulations for wetting, dispersing, and emulsifying applications. It delivers strong surface activity in aqueous systems, enabling uniform distribution of active ingredients. This chemical compound facilitates improved substrate penetration and ensures the stability of complex mixtures. In agrochemical formulations, it acts as a dispersant and wetting agent in wettable powder and suspension concentrate pesticides. By improving raindrop coverage and leaf adhesion, it enhances the efficacy of agricultural treatments. Textile and leather processors use it to enhance dye penetration and ensure level dyeing across various fiber substrates. In paper manufacturing, it supports pulp processing and surface sizing by reducing surface tension. This promotes even coating distribution and improves the overall quality of the finished paper products during the production cycle. Industrial and institutional cleaning formulations incorporate it to improve soil release and substrate wetting on hard surfaces. It is highly effective in demanding environments where rapid wetting and high electrolyte tolerance are required. The product is supplied as a powder or as an aqueous solution, with the powder form being the most common for industrial handling. Technical grade is the standard specification available for agricultural and textile applications. Bulk supply is typically offered in bags or drums depending on the physical form and customer requirements. It remains a versatile component for manufacturers seeking reliable performance in diverse chemical processing and cleaning sectors.
